Submission Instructions

  1. Select 20 consecutive words from your primary manuscript witness.
  2. Tier 1 (Manual): For each word, look up its canonical dictionary lemma and provide a full morphological breakdown (part of speech, gender/number/case or tense/voice/mood) in a Markdown table (LEMMATIZATION_POLICIES.md).
  3. Tier 2 (NLP Engine): Run the excerpt through a computational tagging script (using SpaCy or TreeTagger) and record the predicted lemmas, POS tags, and token accuracy in NLP_BENCHMARK.md.
  4. Tier 3 (LLM): Query an AI model in VS Code using structured prompt engineering with Universal Dependencies UPOS constraints and negative constraints.
  5. Three-Way Diff & Merge: Perform a three-way diff (Manual vs NLP vs AI) in LINGUISTIC_AUDIT.md. Merge the best reading of each token into linguistic_merged.xml, noting the source (M/N/A) and rationale for every choice. Manual is the default, not the winner by fiat.
  6. TEI Encoding: Synthesize transcription_linguistic.xml using <w lemma="..." pos="..." resp="...">token</w> elements, validating against the course schema with xmllint.
  7. Reflection: Submit your validated TEI XML file, tagging script/prompts, and a 300–500 word reflection in LINGUISTIC_AUDIT.md analyzing automated error patterns, OOV rates, and morphological disambiguation.
